timeline.text: A kid learning fractions got a honey pot standing in for a honeycomb — the wrong picture, teaching the wrong idea.
Every lesson card just grabbed the nearest emoji and hoped it matched.
Now a shared kit called drawSpec draws the real shape, at one true scale.
The same kit checks the answer, so picture and check can never disagree.
No stand-ins: with no exact picture, the card is refused, not shipped wrong — real pictures now, across all 6.
